chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musadif has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah have mercy on him—from Abdullah ibn Jafar al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Musadif.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: al-Himyari, the familial attribution of a transmitter
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: al-Mutawakkil, part of the name of a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.مُصَادِفٍ: Musadif, the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Musadif in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Musadif in this section of the book. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is central to hadith preservation and evaluation in Shia scholarly tradition.
